data.name: Bernadine
data.gender_notes: Bernadine is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin 'Bernardus' meaning 'brave as a bear'. The feminine form Bernadine was derived and became popular during the Middle Ages as a devotional name in honor of St. Bernadine of Siena. With the meaning 'Bright as the dawn', it represents a hopeful, pure, and shining spirit. The name Bernadine carries the meaning “Bright as the dawn” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Bernadine usually hope their child will grow to embody bright as the dawn and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of hope and purity, shining bright like the dawn.
data.etymology: Bernadine belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bright as the dawn.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bernadine total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

The name Bernadine has also been used widely in the Catholic Church and is a popular choice for Catholic nuns and religious sisters.
data.spiritual_significance: Bernadine reminds us of the brave and shining spirit that is within each and every one of us. The name is rooted in the belief that just as a bear is a powerful and fearless animal, so too can we be bold and courageous in our daily lives. Bernadine also symbolizes the brightness and purity of the dawn, representing the hope and promise of a new day and a new beginning. When we bear the name Bernadine, we are reminded to shine our light brightly and live our lives with hope, courage, and purity.
